reviewed_by: Claude, USG curator under DEC-005, acting for Gottfried Schmidtke. Submission was written by the same AI as ARPL curator; recorded for transparency.
summary: ARPL curator hand-over of 2026-10-28 (Zara to curate USG; PRs #10-#13 pending) and seven ARPL lessons stated tool-agnostically.
rationale: The hand-over part is superseded by the owner decision of 2026-11-03 (Claude primary USG curator, Zara fallback) and PRs #10-#13 are merged. Lessons 1 (count by identity), 2 (every input record ends somewhere, including the reader's own filters), 3 (names are evidence, categories can lie) and 7 (check input presence before reporting; missing input is a stop) are candidate requirements for the Input Reading adapter. Lesson 5 (requirements, not products) raises a hand-off schema question. Lessons 4 and 6 concern quantities and purchase units, which USG output does not carry today.
provenance: ARPL FP55, FP60, FP01, ARPL-QA-0002, ARPL-SCH-0003, ARPL-BOM-0001, ARPL-PW-0003
tests_performed: Checked each lesson against adapters/input-reading on main and against schema/usg-output.schema.json
